fusions.name: Point-First Throw
fusions.desc: Throws the blade point-first at a target up to 8 tiles away, dealing 30 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. It ignores armour.

fusions.name: Into the Stitch
fusions.desc: A precise chop into an open wound that deals 8 damage, makes the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

fusions.name: Steady the Edge
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Pinpricked Seams
fusions.desc: Every hit you land marks a weak point on that enemy, up to 5. Your next critical hit on it spends them all and strikes it for 34% of your weapon damage per mark (170% at full). Unfed, a mark fades every 4 seconds.
